title: Tinker Airmen Assist Tornado Victims-TV Story
description: 600 Airmen from Tinker Air Force Base, Okla., volunteer to assist tornado victims in Moore, Oklahoma May 24, 2013.  An EF-5 tornado devastated the central Oklahoma town May 20, 2013, causing an estimated $2 billion in damage.
